^\\[@vue/compiler-sfc\\] <(button|div)>: Vue's compiler knows the content model of select from before customizable select, which allows a button and option groups in it
^\\[@vue/compiler-sfc\\] <legend> cannot: Vue's compiler knows the content model of optgroup from before customizable select, which allows a legend in it
^\\[@vue/compiler-sfc\\] <span> cannot b: Vue's compiler knows the content model of option from before customizable select, which allows phrasing content in it
^a11y_label_has_associated_control:: the Grouped example of Select names each option group with a label through aria-labelledby, as customizable select allows
^a11y_media_has_caption:: the clips in the Videos example of Carousel have no speech to caption
^a11y_no_noninteractive_tabindex:: a scroll container in an example takes tabindex="0" so the keyboard can scroll it
^a11y_role_supports_aria_props_implicit:: Rating sets aria-invalid on each radio in every framework; filed in TODO.md under Accessibility
